corrections.old_text: ሰባተኛው ሰንጠረጋr ሁለቱ ወንጌላውያን ማቴዎስና ዮሐንስ የሚተባበሩበት።
corrections.corrected_text: ሰባተኛው ሰንጠረዥ ሁለቱ ወንጌላውያን ማቴዎስና ዮሐንስ የሚተባበሩበት።
corrections.reason: The old lead-type glyph for ዥ (split into two halves in this typeface) was misread by Stage-1 OCR as 'ጋr' including a Latin character. The word is clearly ሰንጠረዥ (table/chart).

corrections.old_text: ስምንተኛው ሰንጠረጋr ሁለቱ ወንጌላውያን ማርቆስና ሉቃስ የሚተባበሩበት።
corrections.corrected_text: ስምንተኛው ሰንጠረዥ ሁለቱ ወንጌላውያን ማርቆስና ሉቃስ የሚተባበሩበት።
corrections.reason: Same old lead-type glyph for ዥ misread as 'ጋr'; corrected to ሰንጠረዥ.
Both visually on the page (6th-order ሕ) and grammatically in Ge'ez (በጽባሕ ተንሥአ, 'in the morning he rose'), the final letter is ሕ, not ሐ.
In Luke 22:37 (ወምስለ ዐማፅያን ተኰልቈ, 'he was numbered with the transgressors'), the printed glyphs clearly show 6th-order ል and labiovelar ቈ/ቆ rather than ለቁ.
